dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Did you hear that Minh got "tạch" last night? No one expected Minh to fail the university entrance exam like that.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: "Tạch"? What does this word mean? My Vietnamese is still quite limited.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Oh, "tạch" means to fail or be unsuccessful. Vietnamese people often use this word when talking about exams or unsuccessful dates.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: So "tạch" means failure... Like our chess game yesterday, cậu completely "tạch" against my move!

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I did "tạch" miserably! But you know, I think "tạch" isn't always a bad thing. Sometimes it teaches us valuable lessons.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hmm... Maybe cậu is right. But why are you smiling when mentioning "tạch"? Is there something cậu haven't told me?
